item.title: Keeping Game Ready: The Living Sisu Hockey League
item.description: When stars like Nick Suzuki of the Montreal Canadiens and Marie-Philip Poulin of the Montreal PWHL Team lace up for summer hockey, they choose the three-on-three three Living Sisu Hockey League (LSHL). Co-founded by Olivier Gervais, Zach Fucale and Alex Atsaidis, the LSHL offers a competitive environment where NHL, PWHL, AHL, and top prospects fine-tune their skills for the upcoming season.

item.title: Hockey Québec s’associe à LiveBarn
item.description: (Montréal, Qc) le vendredi 24 mai 2024 – C’est avec plaisir que Hockey Québec annonce avoir conclu une entente de partenariat avec LiveBarn. En plus d’appuyer le développement du réseau de diffusion en direct LiveBarn dans la province, ce partenariat reflète la volonté de Hockey Québec de se doter d’outils afin de rendre notre sport plus accessible et sécuritaire.

item.title: LiveBarn Named One of Canada’s Enterprise-Industry Leaders Winners
item.description: Montreal, November 7, 2024 – LiveBarn was honoured as an Enterprise-Industry Leaders award winner as part of Deloitte’s 2024 Technology Fast 50 program. The award recognizes the fastest-growing enterprise-level technology, media, and telecommunications companies by revenue growth percentage over their last four years of operation. This category is open to companies that recorded a minimum revenue of $10 million in 2020 and $50 million in 2023.

item.title: LiveBarn Community Participates in Memorial Vigil For American Airlines Flight 5342
item.description: February 4, 2025 - After the tragic incident that occurred with American Airlines Flight 5342, Gina Shinn from Extreme Ice Center in Indian Trail, NC, reached out to LiveBarn to share her vision for a memorial vigil she was organizing in memory of the lives lost. On Monday, February 3rd, between 3:35-3:40pm, over 60 LiveBarn venues participated in the memorial vigil organized by Gina to memorialize the members of the USFSA family that lost their lives.
